concerns.text: Unsafe [P] tags. T003's run_e2e executes the T002 ingest; T004 reads unified_fatigue.csv (T002); T005 reads T004's feature sets; T006 reads T005's models/test errors; T009 gates on T008's eligibility JSON; T010 reads all data/results/*.csv; T011 reads T010's runtime_summary.csv; T012 lists T011's artifacts. Every one of these is tagged [P] (parallel-safe) yet has a hard producer-before-consumer dependency. Only T001/T002 (independent of each other) and the T006/T007 pair are genuinely parallel-safe. Remove or correct the [P] tags on T003, T004, T005, T008, T009, T010, T011, T012 so the tags match the stated execution order.
